examples.text: „Die Branche hat sich an den Fuß des Affenfelsens zurückgezogen, weil die gibraltarische Regierung großzügig Glücksspiellizenzen an private Anbieter vergibt.“

translations.source_sense_description: das britische Überseegebiet Gibraltar betreffend, zu ihm gehörend, von ihm stammend

glosses: Of or pertaining to Gibraltar or its people

examples.text: The curse has been Spanish ineptitude feeding Gibraltarian intransigence. Border hold-ups are counterproductive to winning hearts and minds, as were blundering Argentinian landings on the outer Falklands.

glosses: A native or inhabitant of Gibraltar.

examples.text: The idea of a British warship supposedly menacing Spain is ludicrous. Is it meant to bomb Cadiz? Will its guns lift a rush-hour tailback in a colony that most Britons regard as awash with tax dodgers, drug dealers and right-wing whingers? The Gibraltarians have rights, but why British taxpayers should send warships to enforce them, even if just "on exercise", is a mystery.

glosses: The dialect spoken in Gibraltar, a mix of British English and Andalusian Spanish.
